name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana (MKSY)
short_description: Zero-premium natural disaster crop relief assistance up to ₹25,000/ha for Kharif crop losses exceeding 33% across Gujarat.
description: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana is a 100% state-funded disaster compensation scheme by the Government of Gujarat. In the event of severe drought, excess unseasonal rainfall, or heavy flood resulting in 33% or more crop damage during the Kharif season, farmers receive direct compensation without paying any insurance premium.
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Gujarat cultivating crops in the Kharif season who have suffered 33% or higher crop damage due to notified weather calamities.
benefits: Direct financial aid: ₹20,000 per hectare for crop loss between 33% and 60%, and ₹25,000 per hectare for loss exceeding 60%, up to a maximum limit of 4 hectares.
documents_required: 7/12 & 8-A land ownership records, Aadhaar Card, Sowing declaration or Talati certification, Bank passbook IFSC copy.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the iKhedut portal (ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in) through Village Computer Entrepreneurs (VCE) at Gram Panchayat eGram centres.
